extracted.stage: Financial remedy proceedings ongoing at the Family Court at Leeds
extracted.summary: A solicitor at Szabo Legal enquires about approximately £28,000 of funding for her client, the husband, in financial remedy proceedings at Leeds where matrimonial assets are around £405,500.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry about funding for your client's financial remedy proceedings. We have noted the estimated costs to conclusion of £28,000 and matrimonial assets of approximately £405,500. To take this further we would need details of the next hearing date and procedural stage, a breakdown of the costs estimate, confirmation of the nature and ownership of the assets in dispute (including the family home and business), and your client's identification and financial disclosure documents. A member of the team will review the information and come back to you. Please do let us know if any further documents are already available.
